task.title: [Bug]: Custom endpoint shows "/v1/api/chat not found" instead of the real error, and a new token needs a restart
task.body:
### What happened?

I set up the Custom LLM provider with Ollama Cloud (base URL `https://ollama.com/v1`, Bearer Token). Every answer failed with:

```
Custom endpoint request failed (404 Not Found): {"error":"path \"/v1/api/chat\" not found"}
```

That message sent me in the wrong direction (I first thought the model name or its `-cloud` suffix was the problem). After digging, it's two separate things:

1. **The real error is thrown away.** NexQ calls `/chat/completions` first and, if that fails for any reason, falls back to Ollama's `/api/chat`. Only the fallback's answer is shown. In my case `/chat/completions` answered `401 Unauthorized` (wrong token), and Ollama Cloud doesn't serve `/api/chat` under `/v1`, so all I ever saw was the 404 for the fallback path.
2. **A new token isn't used until NexQ restarts.** With Custom as the active provider, pasting a new token in Settings stores it, but the running provider keeps the old one. Spaces around a pasted token are also sent as part of it, which gives another 401.

Both `gemma4:31b` and `gemma4:31b-cloud` work against Ollama Cloud with a correct Bearer token, so the model name wasn't the problem.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Settings > LLM > Custom: base URL `https://ollama.com/v1`, auth **Bearer Token**, a wrong token (or the right one with a trailing space).
2. Make Custom the active provider, start a meeting and ask for an answer.
3. See `404 Not Found ... path "/v1/api/chat" not found`.
4. Paste the correct token and ask again: same error until NexQ restarts.

### Expected behavior

- The error says what the endpoint actually answered for each path NexQ tried, e.g. `/chat/completions answered 401 Unauthorized`.
- A token changed while Custom is in use applies at once, without spaces around it.

### NexQ version

2.32.0 (the code is the same on main at 2.33.0)

### Operating system

Windows 11

### OS version and hardware

Windows 11 (build 26300)

### Area

AI responses (LLM)

### STT provider(s)

Not relevant

### LLM provider(s)

Custom endpoint

### Logs

With extra logging on a test build (token lengths only), the first request's real answer:

```
INFO  [llm::custom] CustomLLM: auth bearer, 40-character credential
WARN  [llm::custom] CustomLLM: /chat/completions answered 401 Unauthorized; trying /api/chat
```

The stored token turned out to be the wrong key (40 characters; the Ollama key is 57). After pasting the right one, the provider in use kept the old token until a restart.

### Screenshots, recordings or log files

_No response_

### Before submitting

- [x] I am using the latest release, or I have confirmed the bug still exists on it.
- [x] I searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate.
- [x] I included my log, or explained why I can't.
- [x] I checked logs and screenshots for personal information.
